chapter: Early recordings and arrival in New York
title: Claude Thornhill pushing her career
summary: Claude was a musician not a booking agent but worked hard, sitting outside the club on the curb.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: But Claude was really responsible for other those/things. He was pretty hard with me because, number one, he had the connections; he had been around
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
for a long time and he had making recordings. And he was really pushing me, you know.
Claude wasn't a booking agent. He was strictly a musician, you see. And he -- I supposed he liked what I was doing. So he worked on it.
And he tried very hard. In fact, there's no doubt about it -- I mean, after I did 'Loch Lomond.' I did become a big success on the Street.
And Claude used to come and sit outside the club on the curb and cry while the crowd was coming in. He was quite happy about that.
That is true! That is true!
